note: Q.4 a.2 co. says whatever perfection is in the effect is in the effective cause; the claim reads 'effect' as a thing whose being the cause causes. The premise says it of every cause of any perfection in any thing. The extension beyond causes of being is the analyst's; its scoped version STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES is derived in CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES-FROM-PREEXISTENCE.
